title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode9 Amateur Painter

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? I'm back in my room?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<K! K, answer me!
Kanade, are you okay?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K, are you there?! Please say something!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Phew... It looks like we all made it back okay.
That's a relief.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What exactly just happened to us?
As soon as Miku touched me, I was back in my room.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<And what was that SEKAI place?
Miku and Yuki were both acting so strange.>

Be honest, K, Enanan, Amia...
You all want to disappear more than anyone.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hiding the fact that she was OWN and laughing at us behind our backs!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I feel like an idiot for saying how great she was like that!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <W-Well, we don't exactly know if she was doing it to be mean. Still...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yuki sure is a lot different than I thought.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I guess you can never tell what someone's really like over voice chat, huh? Haha.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I don't see what's funny about this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<So what do we do now?
After that, I don't think Yuki is going to be coming back.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Maybe we should call it a night.
I think we're all a little worn out.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We can talk more about Yuki and what we're going to do from here on out tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I don't see any reason to talk about her after this. She basically said she wants to work alone. It's not like she's coming back!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If she can make songs like that all on her own, then...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Come on, let's talk about it later once we've all had some time to cool off. See you tomorrow♪>
K, the first time I heard your songs, I felt like they had saved me. A little bit.
But it wasn't enough. I wasn't able to find anything.
I didn't see any reason to tell you, so I didn't.
I've never spoken to you as anyone other than Yuki, after all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now that she can write songs like that by herself, she just doesn't care about us normies anymore, is that it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She gets 200,000 views on her own, and then decides she doesn't need us?

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<It felt delicate and gentle, but also a little sad.
I thought it was wonderful.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How dare she...make fun of me like that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She never cared for my art one bit!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll show her! I'll keep drawing until I become bigger than her, then I can pay her back for making me look stupid!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
This is terrible.
The draft looked just fine, but now the perspective is all wrong.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I just can't get it to work.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This isn't good enough... No matter what I do...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What are you doing?
You think it's okay to barge into my room whenever you want, Dad?!

rows.Speaker: Ena's Father
rows.Line: I just thought you'd fallen asleep with the light on.

rows.Speaker: Ena's Father
rows.Line: What are you doing up so late? Were you drawing again?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Does it upset the genius artist when his talentless daughter draws?

rows.Speaker: Ena's Father
rows.Line:
Anyone can draw.
There's no rule that says you need to have talent to do it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why is it that all these people with talent think it's okay to belittle me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Making me look like an idiot!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ena, it's the middle of the night. Keep it down, will ya? This about Dad again?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Shut up!
This has nothing to do with you, Akito! Get out!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, whatever. You're the one who needs to shut up, though.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Draw as much as you like, but you need to sleep too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to keep drawing! I have to keep drawing! If I keep drawing, then even I could...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can I really make something as good as...that?

rows.Speaker: Social Media Comment
rows.Line: <Enanan, you're as cute as ever today!>

rows.Speaker: Social Media Comment
rows.Line: <You're so beautiful I actually said it out loud!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's so easy to get people to notice me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But who cares... Why can't I...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I need to draw, but I just...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why do things have to be like this?
You all want to disappear more than anyone.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She's right. I just want to disappear forever.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why does the one who understands me have to be her?
